consumers: root launch.py validates stay-watch/Cargo.toml and stay-watch/src files
root launch.py builds stay-watch/Cargo.toml with --package stay-watch
stay-watch/src/main.rs derives repository root from CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR parent
scripts/test_launch.py asserts the manifest path and binary name
scripts/rust-install-check is a separate Cargo fixture
state.root_cleanliness_intent: Remove confusing owned source folders while preserving the root launch.py entry point.

candidates.retain_stay_watch: Keep the current stay-watch/Cargo.toml, stay-watch/Cargo.lock, and stay-watch/src.
candidates.rename_app: Move the package directory to app/ and keep Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, and src under app/.
candidates.root_cargo_src: Move the one application Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock to the repository root and move its four Rust source files to root src/.
